rules.title: Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C relocation payments
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation to each tenant, up to a per-unit maximum, plus an additional amount for elderly, disabled or minor-child households. The amount depends on the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child; for notices served 3/01/26 to 2/28/27

coverage.summary: Applies to covered San Francisco tenancies terminated for the listed no-fault reasons.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by Civil Code 1947.9 instead.

rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

rules.title: Ellis Act relocation payments
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act must receive relocation payments per tenant, up to a per-unit maximum, plus an additional amount for each elderly or disabled tenant. The amount depends on the date the eviction notice is served.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant; for notices served 3/01/26 to 2/28/27

coverage.summary: Applies to tenants evicted under the Ellis Act in San Francisco.

rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
